is_anopheles.evidence: The study examines Anopheles gambiae s.l. (Tiassalé strain) and Anopheles gambiae s.s. (Kisumu strain).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper does not report new genotype data for any of the listed insecticide-resistance markers. It only mentions previously published resistance frequencies (kdr, Ace-1R) in the Tiassalé population as background information (page 4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies are reported for the mosquitoes used in this study.

african_field_population.evidence: The Tiassalé strain was collected as larvae from rice fields in Tiassalé, Côte d'Ivoire.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study evaluating the sublethal effects of insecticides on mosquito life-history traits.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study was conducted in Tiassalé, Côte d'Ivoire (5° 54′ N, 4° 50′ W).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study was conducted from October 2023 to September 2024.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new experimental work on sublethal effects.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data for the study's conclusions are included in the main text and tables.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the sublethal effects of broflanilide, chlorfenapyr, and deltamethrin on the longevity, blood-feeding success, and reproductive traits of insecticide-resistant Anopheles gambiae s.l. from Tiassalé, Côte d'Ivoire, compared to the susceptible Kisumu strain. The study did not perform any new genotyping of resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: reports_target_markers: The paper does not report new genotype data for any of the listed insecticide-resistance markers.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No genotype counts or frequencies are reported for the mosquitoes used in this study.
